maddeler.e:
نعصوصب (form XII)
# نَعْصَوْصِبُ (naʕṣawṣibu) /naʕ.sˤaw.sˤi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْصَوْصَبَ (iʕṣawṣaba)
# نَعْصَوْصِبَ (naʕṣawṣiba) /naʕ.sˤaw.sˤi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْصَوْصَبَ (iʕṣawṣaba)
# نَعْصَوْصِبْ (naʕṣawṣib) /naʕ.sˤaw.sˤib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِعْصَوْصَبَ (iʕṣawṣaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
